sample_unit: survey respondents (GPs and primary care providers)

links.outcome: Proportion of AI scribe users reporting seeking patient consent before use
links.effect: Among AI scribe users, 59% (n = 35) reported seeking patient consent, so a substantial minority did not seek consent.
links.quote: Only 66% (n = 41) had read the terms and conditionss of the AI scribe tool, and 59% (n = 35) reported seeking patient consent.

screen.reason: Survey of primary care providers on their real-world use, perceived benefits, and safety/governance concerns (including consent rates) regarding ambient AI scribes.
